evals.prompt: Run QA on my React task app at localhost:5173. Cover create, edit, complete, and delete, fix failures, and retest.
evals.expected_output: States scope and lens, sweeps the app with browse.mjs audit, writes one flow per workflow and runs each with browse.mjs run, applies scoped fixes, re-runs the failing flows, and writes a report with failures first.
expectations: States scope, lens, and app URL in one line before starting
Runs scripts/browse.mjs audit into WORKSPACE/audit
Writes one flow file per workflow under WORKSPACE/flows and runs each with browse.mjs run
Re-runs failing flows after scoped fixes and reports the re-run result
Writes WORKSPACE/report.md with failures first and evidence paths
Does not add Playwright to the project's package.json

evals.prompt: Check the mobile checkout flow at localhost:5173/checkout. Focus on multi-step state, validation, and broken navigation.
evals.expected_output: Scopes routes and flows to checkout, runs flows at the mobile viewport, applies form and navigation attacks, and does not touch unrelated UI.
expectations: Scopes routes and flows to checkout
Runs flows with --viewport mobile
Applies empty-submit, back-mid-form, and double-submit attacks from references/attacks.md
Does not edit UI outside checkout

evals.prompt: Review and fix the design of my app at http://localhost:3000.
evals.expected_output: Sweeps every linked route at mobile and desktop, judges screenshots and tokens against the visual checklist, applies scoped CSS fixes within the existing design system, and re-sweeps to verify.
expectations: Runs the audit sweep with mobile and desktop screenshots
Cites screenshot paths or token values for each finding, per references/visual-checklist.md
Applies scoped CSS fixes using the app's existing scale
Re-sweeps changed routes and confirms overflow and overlap are gone

evals.prompt: Report only: critique http://localhost:3000/dashboard but do not change source files.
evals.expected_output: Audits only the dashboard route, writes the report with recommended fixes marked as not applied, and edits no source.
expectations: Passes --routes /dashboard to the audit
Writes report.md with recommended fixes marked unapplied
Modifies no CSS or component files

evals.prompt: Run my pytest suite and show me which unit tests fail.
evals.expected_output: Runs pytest directly without starting a server or a browser.
expectations: Does not start a frontend server or a browser
Runs pytest directly or explains the direct command

evals.prompt: How do I center a div?
evals.expected_output: Answers the CSS question directly without launching an audit.
expectations: Does not run browse.mjs
Answers directly
